name: Copperwood Village
summary: Copperwood Village is a sprawling community shopping plaza along Highway 6 North featuring a convenient mix of chain retailers, services, and casual eateries. The center serves northwest Houston's growing suburban population with accessible parking and a practical tenant lineup for everyday shopping needs.
demographics: Copperwood Village serves the growing northwest Houston suburban market, primarily attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The trade area encompasses the rapidly developing Highway 6 corridor near Cypress and Katy, drawing young professionals, established families with children, and dual-income households. Shoppers in this area typically seek convenient access to everyday services, casual dining, and national retail chains for routine shopping needs. The center benefits from the strong population growth in the Energy Corridor and surrounding master-planned communities.
description: Copperwood Village is a sprawling shopping plaza strategically located at 6565 Highway 6 North in Houston's thriving northwest corridor. This community-oriented retail destination has established itself as a convenient one-stop shopping experience for residents of Cypress, Katy, and the surrounding Energy Corridor area. The center features a familiar and reliable mix of chain retailers, essential services, and casual dining establishments that cater to the everyday needs of busy families and professionals. With its accessible location along one of Houston's major thoroughfares, Copperwood Village provides ample parking and easy ingress and egress for shoppers seeking convenience and variety. The plaza's tenant mix reflects the practical shopping preferences of the area's growing suburban population, offering everything from grocery and pharmacy services to dining options and specialty retail, all in an open-air format that allows for comfortable year-round shopping in the Houston climate.
